label: Kitchen chimney

questions.text: How much frying or oily cooking is done?
How often are the filters cleaned (or the auto-clean run)?
questions.why: Clogged filters reduce suction and strain the motor.
Long or bent ducts reduce suction.

questions.text: Was it installed by the brand's technician at the recommended height?
questions.why: Height and fitting affect suction and safety.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.

questions.text: Have you noticed weak suction, oil dripping or loud noise?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off the chimney at the wall before cleaning the filters.
care_tips.why: Cleaning while powered risks a shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the chimney motor yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Clean the filters (or run the auto-clean) as your manual describes.
care_tips.why: Clogged filters reduce suction and strain the motor.

care_tips.text: Keep the chimney running for a few minutes after cooking.
care_tips.why: This clears the remaining smoke and moisture.

care_tips.text: Ask the brand's service to check the height and duct if suction is weak.
Use a surge protector if the power is unsteady.
care_tips.why: Power swings can damage the motor and controls.

care_tips.text: If suction gets weak, oil drips or the noise gets loud, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: A clogged or failing motor gets worse with use.

reminders.text: Clean the chimney filters or run the auto-clean.
reminders.interval_text: about once a month with regular cooking
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.

risk_factors.question: duct
risk_factors.reason: Long or bent ducts reduce suction.

risk_factors.question: symptoms
risk_factors.reason: These are signs of a fault.

warranty_structure.note: Covered for a standard period - check your warranty card.
Some brands cover the motor for longer - check your warranty card.

exclusions_to_look_for: Damage from oil build-up when filters are not cleaned
Installation by people the brand has not authorised
